# Camouflare 1.3.1

> Draft for maintainer review. Remove this note before publishing the GitHub Release.

Camouflare 1.3.1 is a patch release that makes navigation timeout handling safer and
increases process headroom for the default two-browser container pool.

## What changed

- Timed-out GET navigations now return a solution only after an HTTP(S) navigation has
  committed, preventing an untouched `about:blank` page from appearing as a successful
  empty response.
- Playwright URL matcher callbacks now handle both string and URL-object forms, keeping
  timeout failures retryable instead of exposing an internal type error.
- The production Compose profile, Docker example, and container smoke profiles now use a
  1024 PID limit for browser process and thread headroom.

## Container image

The immutable release image is available for Linux `amd64` and `arm64`:

```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/mehmetcansahin/camouflare:1.3.1
```

See the
[changelog](https://github.com/mehmetcansahin/camouflare/blob/v1.3.1/CHANGELOG.md#131---2026-07-26)
for the complete entry and the
[deployment guide](https://github.com/mehmetcansahin/camouflare/blob/v1.3.1/docs/deployment.md)
for production constraints and rollback guidance.
